Specification: This module is a small test specification for tuples, Cartesian products, sequences, function sets, and related TLC-evaluable expressions. It models a trivial one-variable state machine where x is a Boolean constant state that is initialized to TRUE and never changes, while the main substantive content is an invariant-like operator that checks a collection of tuple-membership, cardinality, DOMAIN, and sequence facts using IF/THEN/ELSE with TLC's Assert and Print operators. The specification is not focused on fault tolerance or liveness; instead, it serves as a regression-style test of tuple construction, nested tuples, Cartesian product membership, and sequence typing in TLA+.
